ttl.name: Front Side Fixed Window Assembly LH

item.ptxt: When working with piano wire, remove the front pillar garnish and attach a protective cover to the curtain shield airbag before removing and installing the front side fixed window.

When installing the front side fixed window, if a clip of the front side fixed window is damaged, the glass can be held in place while the adhesive hardens by using butyl tape instead of the damaged clip, so the front side fixed window can be reused.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Pillar Garnish Corner Piece LH

atten4.ptxt: Remove using the same procedure as for the RH side.

s2.ptxt: Pull the upper part of the garnish in the direction of arrow (1) shown in the illustration to disengage the 2 clips.
Using nippers or equivalent, cut the front pillar garnish clip.
Pull the garnish in the direction of arrow (2) shown in the illustration, disengage the guide and remove the front pillar garnish LH.
Using a clip remover, remove the front pillar garnish clip from the front pillar LH.

atten3.ptxt: Be sure to replace the installed front pillar garnish clip with a new one.
Immediately after removing the front pillar garnish LH, install a protective cover onto the curtain shield airbag.

s3.ptxt: Using cloth or nylon, wrap the airbag portion as shown in the illustration and fix both ends of the cloth or nylon with packing tape.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Side Fixed Window Assembly LH

item.ptxt: Front side fixed window clips are installed at the positions on the front side fixed window assembly LH shown in the illustration, so take care not to damage the front side fixed window assembly LH when cutting.
Use a windshield knife or piano wire as appropriate, depending on the cutting location and conditions.
Because the front side fixed window assembly LH may fall during the work, hold the front side fixed window assembly LH from outside the vehicle using suction cups.

s2.ptxt: Apply protective tape to the body surface around the front side fixed window assembly LH.
Attach suction cups to the front side fixed window assembly LH.

s3.ptxt: Apply plenty of soapy water to the bonded area.
Insert a windshield knife into the bonded area.

Using a windshield knife, while keeping the blade at a right angle to the edge of the front side fixed window assembly LH and matching the blade to the surface and edge of the front side fixed window assembly LH, pull it parallel to the edge of the front side fixed window assembly LH to cut the adhesive.

atten3.ptxt: Never pry with the windshield knife.

atten4.ptxt: Start at a location where the gap between the front side fixed window assembly LH and body is wide.

s3.ptxt: Pass piano wire (0.6mm is suitable) through at the position shown in the illustration, and attach both ends to a mighty puller.
Pull the piano wire alternately to cut the adhesive, leaving the front side fixed window clips.

item.ptxt: Do not let the piano wire contact the edge of the front side fixed window assembly LH strongly.
Be careful, as the piano wire will break if crossed.

s2.ptxt: Holding the suction cups, disengage the 3 front side fixed window clips and remove the front side fixed window assembly LH.

atten3.ptxt: Be careful not to drop the front side fixed window assembly LH.
